questions.script: Woman: What time does the museum close today? Man: At six, but the last entry is at five thirty.
questions.question: When is the last entry to the museum?
questions.questionZh: 博物馆最后的入场时间是几点？
questions.transcript: Woman: What time does the museum close today? Man: At six, but the last entry is at five thirty.

questions.script: Many cities are replacing car lanes with bike paths. Supporters argue that this reduces traffic and pollution, and that cyclists spend more in local shops than drivers. Critics worry about delivery vehicles and people with limited mobility. So far, the data suggests that well-designed paths attract far more riders than expected.
questions.question: What does the data suggest about bike paths?
questions.questionZh: 数据显示自行车道带来了什么？
options: They attract more riders than expected
questions.transcript: Many cities are replacing car lanes with bike paths. Supporters argue that this reduces traffic and pollution, and that cyclists spend more in local shops than drivers. Critics worry about delivery vehicles and people with limited mobility. So far, the data suggests that well-designed paths attract far more riders than expected.

questions.script: A recent survey of remote workers found that productivity stayed stable, but feelings of isolation rose sharply in the first six months. The strongest predictor of wellbeing was not the number of meetings, but whether colleagues had regular one-to-one chats. Companies that scheduled informal check-ins reported the lowest stress levels.
questions.question: What best predicted remote workers' wellbeing?
questions.questionZh: 最能预测远程员工幸福感的因素是什么？
questions.transcript: A recent survey of remote workers found that productivity stayed stable, but feelings of isolation rose sharply in the first six months. The strongest predictor of wellbeing was not the number of meetings, but whether colleagues had regular one-to-one chats. Companies that scheduled informal check-ins reported the lowest stress levels.

questions.script: Sleep researchers now say that a consistent bedtime matters more than total hours. Volunteers who slept the same seven hours but at irregular times performed worse on memory tests than those with a steady schedule. The lesson is simple: your brain values rhythm as much as rest.
questions.question: According to the passage, what matters most for memory?
questions.questionZh: 根据短文，对记忆力最重要的是什么？
questions.transcript: Sleep researchers now say that a consistent bedtime matters more than total hours. Volunteers who slept the same seven hours but at irregular times performed worse on memory tests than those with a steady schedule. The lesson is simple: your brain values rhythm as much as rest.

questions.script: Historians of technology caution against assuming that new tools simply replace old ones. The typewriter did not eliminate handwriting, and email did not end the phone call; instead, each new medium reshaped when and why we use the others. Adoption, they argue, is less a switch than a slow rebalancing of habits.
questions.question: What is the historians' main point?
questions.questionZh: 历史学家的主要观点是什么？
options: New tools fully replace old ones
New media reshape how we use older ones
questions.transcript: Historians of technology caution against assuming that new tools simply replace old ones. The typewriter did not eliminate handwriting, and email did not end the phone call; instead, each new medium reshaped when and why we use the others. Adoption, they argue, is less a switch than a slow rebalancing of habits.
